decision.selected: gpt-5.6-luna with executed actions, current-attempt browser input inventory, and shared keyboard evidence guidance
decision.runtimeEffect: No additional LLM call, model escalation, proof gate or stored-prompt migration. Additional prompt tokens are not free.
decision.reason: Action logs alone preserved all three false c11 approvals. Selected combination identified missing keyboard evidence in three archived-root replays and matched all fourteen controlled judgments.

limitations: Exploratory sequential stages, registered separately before execution; small single-incident sample, not a held-out reliability estimate.
Root replays use the exact archived system/user input plus each registered treatment. They isolate this change and do not replay a fresh run with every later production change.
The original library application has not been shown to be keyboard-broken: the observed defect was unsupported acceptance.
One selected root replay also cited earlier browser errors. Both explicit recovered-keyboard controls passed; complex recovery judgments remain a risk.
No new production run was launched. Production MCP read access returned authentication required.
Executor guidance propagation is tested, but end-to-end production execution of a keyboard journey after this change is not yet measured.
Equivalent keyboard tests outside validate_html are permitted by guidance but were not covered by these seven browser controls.

reproduction.outputs: *-responses.jsonl and responses.jsonl retain raw model responses, parsed verdicts, usage and request hashes.
reproduction.protocols: Each stage has a protocol JSON with its registered scope and call count.
reproduction.transport: Production CodexCliLlmClient, tool-free validation, temperature 0, maxTokens 2048. Optional ATOMA_REPLAY_CODEX_BINARY permits reading only the local executable under the existing text-only filesystem policy.
reproduction.commands: Run replay*.mjs with node --import tsx; --live spends model quota. Input hash checks prevent reusing responses against changed inputs. prepare-cases.mjs regenerates real browser fixtures and must not overwrite this measured archive.
